I don’t have real‑time access to a calendar API, so I can’t pull an official “long‑weekend” list directly from a government source. However, I can give you a quick rundown of the Canadian public holidays that, in 2023, fell on a Friday or Monday (or were close enough to create a three‑day weekend). You can cross‑check these dates against your local provincial/territorial holiday calendars to confirm they apply to your specific region.

| Date | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | Creates a 4‑day weekend if you take the preceding Friday off. |
| **January 16** | Monday | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Long weekend in those provinces. |
| **February 20** | Monday | Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | Long weekend in Manitoba. |
| **March 17** | Friday | St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario) | Long weekend in Ontario. |
| **April 7** | Monday | Good Friday | Long weekend nationwide. |
| **May 22** | Monday | Victoria Day | Long weekend nationwide. |
| **June 19** | Monday | National Indigenous Peoples Day | Long weekend nationwide. |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day | Creates a 4‑day weekend if you take the preceding Friday off. |
| **September 18** | Monday | Labour Day | Long weekend nationwide. |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving (Canada) | Long weekend nationwide. |
| **November 7** | Friday | Remembrance Day (observed) | Long weekend in some provinces (e.g., Alberta, British Columbia). |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | Long weekend nationwide. |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | Creates a 4‑day weekend if you take the preceding Friday off. |

### How to use this list

1. **Check Provincial/Territorial Variations** – Some holidays (e.g., Family Day, Louis Riel Day, Victoria Day) are province‑specific. Verify which provinces observe each holiday.
2. **Add Your Own Holidays** – If you’re in a province that has additional holidays (e.g., Heritage Day in BC, St. George’s Day in PEI), add those to your schedule.
3. **Plan Your Time Off** – For holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, you can often get a 3‑day weekend. If a holiday falls on a Wednesday, you might consider taking the adjacent Friday or Monday off to create a 4‑day stretch.

If you need a definitive, up‑to‑date list, I recommend checking the Government of Canada’s official public holiday calendar or your provincial government’s website. Let me know if you’d like help formatting this data for your app or if you need assistance with a specific province!
